offence_category.reason: Case concerns murder under s.302 IPC, matching Murder.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Sessions Judge convicted under s.302 IPC and imposed life imprisonment on 13.07.1991.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court allowed appeals and acquitted the appellants.

offence_finally_established.reason: Appellants were acquitted, so no offence is finally established.
